coordinateSpace: Normalized original base-art canvas, before aspect-preserving contain fit. x is right, y is down. All lengths scale independently with native art width/height before square fitting.
headWeight: 1 - smoothstep(neckBand[0], neckBand[1], y); if xFade exists multiply by 1 - smoothstep(xFade[0],xFade[1],x). Rotate inverse source coordinates around pivot by -angle * weight; do not merely add rotation displacement from an ellipse at the center of the face. All eyes/mouth patches must already be composited before this warp. Facial rectangle bottoms are above the neck fade.
headTiming: Willow, River, Sol, Stone and Fern use a smooth 4.2-second tilt starting 4 seconds into each 16-second interval; they rest between gestures and alternate direction. Sage retains its gentle 12.8- and 8.3-second blended sway. A listening-state transition eases over 450 ms toward a small attentive tilt and reduces tail motion by 80% and head lift by 35%, without restarting breathing. All channels use continuous active time.
tailWeight: Projection t = dot(p - pivot, tip - pivot) / dot(tip - pivot,tip - pivot); smoothstep(axisFade[0],axisFade[1],t) makes root stationary. Multiply by 1 - smoothstep(.55,1,ellipseDistanceSquared). If clipX exists multiply smoothstep(clipX[0],clipX[1],x), similarly clipY. Translation follows perpendicular unit axis times maxTipOffset and a gesture envelope. Coordinates are original art normalized; contain-fit before rendering.
tailTiming: A smooth 3.2-second two-lobe burst begins 1 second into each 11.2-second interval, with exact rest between bursts. Listening reduces its amplitude by 80%. Reduced Motion stops it. No separate tail timer or audio sampling.
importantLimit: These are authored 2D distortion rigs. They cannot reveal hidden surfaces. Do not advertise as 3D or promise free head turns. Suggested angles/offsets need real rendered phone-size pixel QA before shipping.

tail.notes: The whole exposed tail rotates as a separate source layer behind the stationary body. The moving source mask includes under-body overlap at the curved haunch seam. The broad support falls off only in transparent padding, preserving the full tip and fur edge. A fixed destination clipping wall is never used.
tail.supportFormula: 1 - smoothstep(.9, 1, ellipseDistanceSquared), evaluated in each source layer; only transparent padding fades. Rigid tail rotation has no destination seam weight.

sage.noTailReason: No visible tail in this frontal owl portrait. Do not wobble wing tips or feet as a substitute.

tail.notes: Only the small segment behind the image-right haunch is exposed. Constrain to x >= .824 with a .018-wide feather; keep the large haunch and rear paw fixed. Tiny tip movement only, not a full tail wag. The visible haunch and attachment are protected by the final horizontal fade; only the exposed tip moves.

sol.noTailReason: The tail is curled across the floor and its pale tip overlaps both front-paw silhouettes. A simple elliptical warp either leaves the true tip stationary, pulls the grounded curl, or moves paw pixels. Omit the Sol wag in this safe rig; retain expressive head/ear tilt and torso breathing. A later tail-specific segmentation and hidden-surface painting pass would support an actual lift.

stone.noTailReason: No exposed tail. Keep shell completely still. The head x fade gives full motion through all facial masks and zero motion at x >= .620, protecting the visible shell.
